name: CV draft — webhook to emailed PDF

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: The only place to edit: where the CV builder runs, and which model drafts.

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Body: { profileId, variantId, targetRole, jobDescription, notifyEmail }

nodes.name: Fetch library catalogue
nodes.notes: Returns { systemPrompt, catalogue } — the prompt lives in the repo, not here.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: $('Config').first().json.model,
  max_tokens: 16000,
  system: $json.systemPrompt,
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: '# Library catalogue — the only IDs you may use

'
        + $json.catalogue
        + '

# Target role
'
        + $('Webhook').first().json.body.targetRole
        + '

# Job description
'
        + $('Webhook').first().json.body.jobDescription
    }
  ]
}) }}

nodes.name: Draft the variant
nodes.notes: Header-auth credential: name 'x-api-key', value the Anthropic API key.

nodes.name: Save variant
nodes.notes: 400 here means the model invented an ID — the response names every one.

nodes.name: Render PDF
nodes.notes: Chromium starts per request — allow a generous node timeout.

parameters.subject: =CV draft ready — {{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.targetRole }}
parameters.message:
=A draft variant has been created from your content library.

Open it in the editor to fine-tune before sending:
{{ $('Config').first().json.baseUrl }}{{ $('Save variant').first().json.editPath }}

The attached PDF is the draft as it stands. Nothing in it was written by the model — every line comes from your library.
